name: directblind
turns: Good afternoon, this is Owen Hale at Meridian Voice.
Hi Owen, it's Paul Grant from Grant Law Office. Our last invoice has a charge for two numbers we cancelled in March.
Thanks, Paul. Billing can credit that for you. I'm going to transfer you to Jordan Blake on our billing team now.
Hi Paul, this is Jordan in billing. Owen said you were charged for two cancelled numbers.
That's right. They were cancelled on March twelfth, but they're still on the invoice.
I see them. I've removed both numbers and added a credit of twenty four dollars to your account. It will show on your next invoice.
You're welcome. Have a good day.
